reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Kansas
    Focus year: 2021

    Question:
    In an eviction (possession) action, can a tenant raise a defense that eviction is unlawful
    because they exercised a legally protected right to call for emergency assistance?

    Statutes encoded (as provided):
      - K.S.A. 58-2572 (2021) Retaliation: protected activities + prohibited retaliatory acts + defense to possession
      - K.S.A. 58-2561 (2021) Nonpayment possession action: counterclaim/waiver (encoded minimally)
      - K.S.A. 58-2559 (2021) Landlord material noncompliance: tenant notice/termination/remedies (encoded minimally)
      - K.S.A. 58-25,137 (2021) DV/SA/HT/Stalking protections (encoded minimally)
      - K.S.A. 58-2553 (2021) Landlord duties materially affecting health and safety (encoded minimally)
*/

/* ----------------------------- */
/* Scenario facts (question)     */
/* ----------------------------- */

jurisdiction(kansas).
focus_year(2021).

tenant(t1).
landlord(l1).

/* Eviction action = action for possession */
action_for_possession(l1, t1).

/* The tenant exercised the asserted right: calling for emergency assistance */
tenant_action(t1, call_emergency_assistance).

/* Timeline: landlord's possession action occurs after the tenant's action */
event_date(tenant_did(t1, call_emergency_assistance), day(1)).
event_date(landlord_did(l1, file_possession_action_against(t1)), day(2)).

/* Tenant's defense theory (as stated): eviction is retaliatory for the emergency call */
landlord_motive(l1, t1, retaliate_for(call_emergency_assistance)).

/* Scenario summary predicate required by the prompt */
scenario_statement :-
    jurisdiction(kansas),
    focus_year(2021),
    tenant(t1),
    landlord(l1),
    action_for_possession(l1, t1),
    tenant_action(t1, call_emergency_assistance),
    landlord_motive(l1, t1, retaliate_for(call_emergency_assistance)),
    event_date(tenant_did(t1, call_emergency_assistance), TenantDay),
    event_date(landlord_did(l1, file_possession_action_against(t1)), LandlordDay),
    TenantDay @< LandlordDay.


/* -------------------------------------------- */
/* K.S.A. 58-2572 (2021) - Retaliation          */
/* -------------------------------------------- */

/* 58-2572(a): Protected tenant activities (enumerated) */
ksa_58_2572_protected_activity(Tenant, complained_to_gov_building_housing_code) :-
    tenant(Tenant).
ksa_58_2572_protected_activity(Tenant, complained_to_landlord_of_violation_under_58_2553) :-
    tenant(Tenant).
ksa_58_2572_protected_activity(Tenant, organized_or_joined_tenants_union) :-
    tenant(Tenant).

/* Helper: map scenario actions to these enumerated protected activities (if any).
   The scenario action call_emergency_assistance is NOT enumerated in 58-2572(a),
   so it intentionally does not map to a protected activity here. */
ksa_58_2572_maps_scenario_action_to_protected(_Tenant, call_emergency_assistance, _Protected) :-
    fail.
ksa_58_2572_maps_scenario_action_to_protected(Tenant, complained_to_gov_building_housing_code, complained_to_gov_building_housing_code) :-
    tenant(Tenant).
ksa_58_2572_maps_scenario_action_to_protected(Tenant, complained_to_landlord_of_violation_under_58_2553, complained_to_landlord_of_violation_under_58_2553) :-
    tenant(Tenant).
ksa_58_2572_maps_scenario_action_to_protected(Tenant, organized_or_joined_tenants_union, organized_or_joined_tenants_union) :-
    tenant(Tenant).

/* 58-2572(a): prohibited retaliatory acts are increasing rent or decreasing services */
ksa_58_2572_prohibited_retaliatory_act(increase_rent).
ksa_58_2572_prohibited_retaliatory_act(decrease_services).

/* 58-2572(c): rent increase allowed if (i) no lease conflict AND (ii) in good faith to compensate certain cost increases.
   Encoded as a permission/exception predicate the landlord may prove. */
ksa_58_2572c_rent_increase_allowed_if_good_faith_costs(LeaseConflict, GoodFaithCostIncrease) :-
    LeaseConflict = no,
    GoodFaithCostIncrease = yes.

/* 58-2572(d): landlord may bring action for possession notwithstanding (a) and (b) if one of the listed grounds exists.
   Encoded as separate grounds. */
ksa_58_2572d_possession_allowed_ground(code_violation_caused_by_tenant_lack_reasonable_care).
ksa_58_2572d_possession_allowed_ground(tenant_default_in_rent).
ksa_58_2572d_possession_allowed_ground(code_compliance_requires_alteration_remodeling_demolition_deprives_use).

/* Core test: landlord violates 58-2572(a) by (increase_rent OR decrease_services) AFTER protected activity,
   subject to rent-increase exception in (c).
   We model the "after" requirement by comparing event dates. */
ksa_58_2572a_retaliation_violation(Landlord, Tenant, Act) :-
    landlord(Landlord),
    tenant(Tenant),
    ksa_58_2572_prohibited_retaliatory_act(Act),
    tenant_action(Tenant, ScenarioAction),
    ksa_58_2572_maps_scenario_action_to_protected(Tenant, ScenarioAction, ProtectedActivity),
    ksa_58_2572_protected_activity(Tenant, ProtectedActivity),
    event_date(tenant_did(Tenant, ScenarioAction), TD),
    event_date(landlord_did(Landlord, did(Act, against(Tenant))), LD),
    TD @< LD,
    ksa_58_2572a_not_excused_under_c(Act, Landlord, Tenant).

/* Sub-helper: rent increases can be excused under (c); decreases in services have no (c) excuse in provided text. */
ksa_58_2572a_not_excused_under_c(decrease_services, _Landlord, _Tenant).
ksa_58_2572a_not_excused_under_c(increase_rent, Landlord, Tenant) :-
    % If landlord can show the (c) conditions, then it IS excused; so "not excused" fails.
    % In this standalone program, those conditions are not present unless explicitly asserted.
    \+ ksa_58_2572c_landlord_proves_exception(Landlord, Tenant).

/* Proof placeholder for (c) exception; not asserted in this scenario. */
ksa_58_2572c_landlord_proves_exception(_Landlord, _Tenant) :-
    fail.

/* 58-2572(b): If landlord violates (a), tenant "has a defense in an action ... for possession" */
ksa_58_2572b_defense_to_possession(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    action_for_possession(_Landlord, Tenant),
    ksa_58_2572a_retaliation_violation(_Landlord2, Tenant, _Act).

/* 58-2572(d): even if (a)/(b) exist, landlord may bring possession action on certain grounds.
   This narrows when the tenant can successfully use the defense.
   For this program, these grounds must be asserted as facts to apply. */
scenario_landlord_possession_ground(_Landlord, _Tenant, _Ground) :-
    fail.

ksa_58_2572_defense_available_in_possession_action(Tenant) :-
    ksa_58_2572b_defense_to_possession(Tenant),
    % If landlord proves a (d) ground, possession can proceed notwithstanding (a)/(b),
    % so defense is not available to defeat possession.
    \+ ( action_for_possession(Landlord, Tenant),
         scenario_landlord_possession_ground(Landlord, Tenant, Ground),
         ksa_58_2572d_possession_allowed_ground(Ground)
       ).


/* ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* K.S.A. 58-2561 (2021) - Nonpayment possession actions  */
/* (Not needed for the question, but encoded minimally)   */
/* ------------------------------------------------------ */

ksa_58_2561a_requires_counterclaim_in_nonpayment_possession_action(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    possession_action_basis(Tenant, nonpayment_of_rent).

possession_action_basis(_Tenant, _Basis) :-
    fail.


/* ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* K.S.A. 58-2559 (2021) - Landlord material noncompliance */
/* (Encoded minimally; not used by the question)          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------ */

ksa_58_2559a_tenant_may_terminate_after_notice(Tenant, NoticeDays) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    NoticeDays >= 30.

ksa_58_2559a1_landlord_cures_if_initiates_good_faith_effort_within_days(Days) :-
    Days =< 14.

ksa_58_2559b_tenant_may_recover_damages_or_injunction(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant).


/* ------------------------------------------------------ */
/* K.S.A. 58-25,137 (2021) - Protected persons (DV/SA/etc) */
/* (Encoded minimally; not used by the question)          */
/* ------------------------------------------------------ */

ksa_58_25137_protected_person(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    protected_person_status(Tenant).

protected_person_status(_Tenant) :-
    fail.

ksa_58_25137a2_no_eviction_based_on_protected_status(Tenant) :-
    ksa_58_25137_protected_person(Tenant).

ksa_58_25137b2_affirmative_defense_no_rent_after_vacate_if_protected_and_notified(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    ksa_58_25137_protected_person(Tenant),
    tenant_vacated(Tenant),
    tenant_notified_landlord_as_required(Tenant).

tenant_vacated(_Tenant) :-
    fail.
tenant_notified_landlord_as_required(_Tenant) :-
    fail.


/* -------------------------------------------- */
/* K.S.A. 58-2553 (2021) - Landlord duties      */
/* (Encoded minimally; not used by the question)*/
/* -------------------------------------------- */

ksa_58_2553a1_landlord_must_comply_building_housing_codes(landlord_duty).
ksa_58_2553a2_landlord_must_exercise_reasonable_care_common_areas(landlord_duty).
ksa_58_2553a3_landlord_must_maintain_appliances_electrical_plumbing_sanitary_hvac(landlord_duty).
ksa_58_2553a4_landlord_must_provide_garbage_receptacles_and_removal(landlord_duty).
ksa_58_2553a5_landlord_must_supply_running_water_hot_water_heat(landlord_duty).


/* ----------------------------- */
/* Reasoning to answer question  */
/* ----------------------------- */

/* The question asks about a defense based on exercising a "legally protected right to call
   for emergency assistance." Under the provided statutes, we check whether that activity
   is protected and yields a defense in an action for possession. */
tenant_can_raise_defense_based_on_emergency_call(Tenant) :-
    tenant(Tenant),
    scenario_statement,
    tenant_action(Tenant, call_emergency_assistance),
    % Defense must be recognized under provided statutes; here we model it via 58-2572.
    ksa_58_2572_defense_available_in_possession_action(Tenant).

housing_answer(yes) :-
    tenant_can_raise_defense_based_on_emergency_call(t1),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that eviction is unlawful because they excercised a legally protected to right to call for emergency assistance?
